class Recorder:
    def __init__(self, codes=None):
        self.calls = []
        self.codes = codes or {}

    def __call__(self, root, run):
        self.calls.append(run.label)
        print(f"RUN {run.label}", flush=True)
        return self.codes.get(run.label, 0)


def write_registry(root, text):
    (root / "build").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "build" / "suites.toml").write_text(text)


def fixture_root(tmp_path, text=FIXTURE):
    write_registry(tmp_path, text)
    for d in ("build", "build/cc_guide", "hooks"):
        (tmp_path / d).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (tmp_path / d / "test_x.py").write_text(TEST_BODY)
    return tmp_path


def call_main(argv, root, run_one=None):
    try:
        return rs.main(argv, root=root, run_one=run_one if run_one is not None else Recorder())
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return exc.code


def by_name(text=FIXTURE):
    return {s.name: s for s in rs.parse(tomllib.loads(text))}


def last_line(captured):
    lines = [l for l in (captured.err or captured.out).splitlines() if l.strip()]
    return lines[-1] if lines else ""


def make_repo(root, tracked=(), untracked=(), registry=None, gitignore=None):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in tracked:
        p = root / f
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(TEST_BODY if Path(f).suffix == ".py" else "x\n")
    if registry is not None:
        write_registry(root, registry)
    if gitignore is not None:
        (root / ".gitignore").write_text(gitignore)
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=root, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=root, check=True)
    for f in untracked:
        p = root / f
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(TEST_BODY)
    return root


def registry_text(*entries):
    return "\n".join(
        f'[[suite]]\nname = "{n}"\ndir = "{d}"\nwith = ["pytest"]\n' for n, d in entries
    )

def default_shells(dir_, deps, pythons):
    withs = " ".join(f"--with {d}" for d in ["pytest", *deps])
    return [f"cd {dir_} && uv run --python {py} {withs} python -m pytest -q" for py in pythons]

def test_runner_imports_stdlib_only():

    names = set()
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            names.update(a.name.split(".")[0] for a in node.names)

def _fake_uv(bindir, code):

    uv = bindir / "uv"
    uv.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n{ pwd -P; printf "%s\\n" "${CALIBRATION_SWEEP-unset}"; '
                  f'printf "%s\\n" "$*"; }} > "$UV_OUT"\nexit {code}\n')
    uv.chmod(uv.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IEXEC)
